text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooooof! That should do it for today's training, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I think we made good prog—huh? Is that?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Wait, don't tell me you're going to follow me the whole way around the perimeter.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But of course! As if I could overlook the hard work of a rival such as you!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Nay, I'll wring every last drop of energy from my body to keep up with you! Ohhh, what a stirring scene!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What scene? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! Yes, we're off to a great start! Now, it's time that I overtake you in a blaze of glory!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohghasfkh! What on earth was that?! One-sided rivalry?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's clear as day. We've got a classic case of "I can't stand to be with her, but I can't stand to be without her." ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Welp! There's nothing for me to do now but run after them… Not too close, but not too far…
choice_data_list: So long as you stay out of sight, okay?
No, you'll wind up overworking yourself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Of course! Not drawing attention to yourself is rule number one of oshi watching!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: When it comes to sneaking around undetected and watching my oshis, not even a ninja can best me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm off for another run! Zooom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, Agnes Digital comes back in a tizzy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Yeah, you're right, I shouldn't run anymore today…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But if I follow them, we don't have to call it training. It's more like recreation. That's it! It's not exercise, it's just simping!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital tries to reason her way into getting my permission, but, unwilling to let her overwork herself, I send her home.
